name: Oshawa–Yorkdale
description: Limited-stop Highway 2 service linking Durham communities with Scarborough Centre and North York. The eastern terminal and the meaning of the 92A suffix have both changed.

timeline.event: Route 92 was introduced in the Highway 2 reorganization replacing the old 94/95 network.
The original timetable shows downtown Oshawa–Yorkdale service; by this edition 92A has become a Dundas/Highway 412–Yorkdale short working.
The main route moved its eastern terminal from downtown Oshawa to Oshawa GO.
The original GTFS retains the later 92A Dundas/Highway 412–Yorkdale short working.

sources.title: Major changes to GO bus service along Highway 2, June 29, 2013 — Transit Toronto
GO revises services September 2, 2014, including 98 replacement by 92A — Transit Toronto
GO revises routes and services, September 5, 2020 — Transit Toronto
Original GO Transit GTFS archived May 5, 2023; use calendar validity, not retrieval date

gaps: The 92A reassignment took place after the recovered 2016 Finch pattern and by the April 2019 timetable; its precise effective date has not been established.
Selected timing-point patterns omit local stops; use the feed snapshots for full dated stop sequences.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
